next:fc:224.hint: 彼は私に挨拶さえしなかった
next:fc:224.question: He didn't so _____ as say hello to me.
next:fc:224.fullSentence: He didn't so much as say hello to me.
next:fc:224.explanation: not so much as doing『〜さえしない』。
next:fc:224.relatedInfo: notを伴わずwithoutと組み合わせても使える(without so much as doing)。

next:fc:225.hint: 『〜さえせずに』を表す慣用表現
next:fc:225.question: 「彼はさよならも言わずに去った」を表すのは?
next:fc:225.fullSentence: He left without so much as saying goodbye.
next:fc:225.explanation: without so much as doing『〜さえせずに』。
next:fc:225.relatedInfo: not so much as doingのwithout版。

next:fc:226.hint: このバッグは私が持っているどれにも劣らず良い
next:fc:226.question: This bag is as good as _____ I have.
next:fc:226.fullSentence: This bag is as good as any I have.
next:fc:226.explanation: as+原級+as any(最上級的な意味を持つ原級表現)。
next:fc:226.relatedInfo: 『どのバッグにも劣らず』という最上級のニュアンス。

next:fc:227.hint: 最上級的な意味を持つas...as ever構文
next:fc:227.question: 「彼はかつて生きた誰にも劣らず勇敢な男だった」を表すのは?
next:fc:227.answer: as brave a man as ever lived
choices: as brave a man as ever lived
as a brave man as ever lived
as brave man as ever lived
so brave a man as ever lived
next:fc:227.fullSentence: He was as brave a man as ever lived.
next:fc:227.explanation: as+原級+as ever lived(最上級的表現)。
next:fc:227.relatedInfo: a+形容詞+名詞の語順(as brave a man)に注意。

next:fc:228.hint: この本はあの本ほど面白くない(比較級の否定)
next:fc:228.question: This book is not _____ interesting than that one.
next:fc:228.fullSentence: This book is not more interesting than that one.
next:fc:228.explanation: 比較級の否定(not+比較級+than)でA≦Bを表す。
next:fc:228.relatedInfo: not as interesting as とほぼ同じ意味になる。

next:fc:229.question: 「トムはジョンよりずっと背が高い」を強調して表すのは?
next:fc:229.fullSentence: Tom is much taller than John.
next:fc:229.explanation: 比較級の強調はmuch, far, still, even, by far, a lot, lots, a great dealを使う(veryは不可)。
next:fc:229.relatedInfo: veryは原級を強調する語であり比較級には使えない。

next:fc:230.hint: 彼は年をとればとるほど、確信を持つようになる
next:fc:230.question: The older he grows, the more _____ he becomes.
next:fc:230.fullSentence: The older he grows, the more certain he becomes.
next:fc:230.explanation: The+比較級SV, the+比較級SV『〜すればするほど…』。
next:fc:230.relatedInfo: 2つの比較級が対応する構文。

next:fc:231.hint: 理由があるからこそ余計に、を表す比較級表現
next:fc:231.question: 「彼女は彼の性格だからこそ余計に彼を愛している」を表すのは?
next:fc:231.fullSentence: She loves him all the more for his character.
next:fc:231.explanation: all the+比較級+for A『Aだから余計に〜』。
next:fc:231.relatedInfo: none the+比較級+for(逆に否定的な文脈)との対比。

next:fc:232.hint: 良い規則は繰り返し言われたからといって悪くなるわけではない
next:fc:232.question: A good rule is _____ the worse for being repeated.
next:fc:232.fullSentence: A good rule is none the worse for being repeated.
next:fc:232.explanation: none the+比較級+for A『Aだからといって少しも〜でない』。
next:fc:232.relatedInfo: all the+比較級+for(肯定的な文脈)との対比。

next:fc:233.hint: 2つのものを対等に否定する比較構文
next:fc:233.question: 「馬が魚でないのと同様、クジラも魚ではない」(クジラ構文)を表すのは?
next:fc:233.fullSentence: A whale is no more a fish than a horse is.
next:fc:233.explanation: no more A than B(通称クジラ構文)。
next:fc:233.relatedInfo: BはAでないことが明白な例を使って否定を強調する。

next:fc:234.hint: 犬が哺乳類であるのと同様、コウモリも哺乳類だ
next:fc:234.question: A bat is no _____ a mammal than a dog is.
next:fc:234.fullSentence: A bat is no less a mammal than a dog is.
next:fc:234.explanation: no less A than B。クジラ構文の逆で、両方とも同程度に肯定される。
next:fc:234.relatedInfo: no more A than B(否定)との対比。

next:fc:235.hint: BができないのとAも同様にできないことを表す比較表現
next:fc:235.question: 「犬が話せないのと同様、チンパンジーも話せない」を表すのは?
next:fc:235.fullSentence: Chimpanzees can no more speak than dogs can.
next:fc:235.explanation: not A any more than B『Bと同様Aも〜ない』。no more...thanの形。

next:fc:236.hint: 幸せな結婚にはお金も愛と同様に必要だ
next:fc:236.question: Money is no less necessary for a happy marriage _____ love is.
next:fc:236.fullSentence: Money is no less necessary for a happy marriage than love is.
next:fc:236.relatedInfo: no more...than(否定)の逆で肯定的な同等比較。

next:fc:237.hint: 多くても、という上限を表す表現
next:fc:237.question: 「せいぜい5ドル」を表すのは?
next:fc:237.fullSentence: I have not more than five dollars.
next:fc:237.explanation: not more than = at most『多くても』。
next:fc:237.relatedInfo: not less than(少なくとも)との対比。

next:fc:238.question: I have not _____ than five dollars.
next:fc:238.fullSentence: I have not less than five dollars.
next:fc:238.explanation: not less than = at least『少なくとも』。
next:fc:238.relatedInfo: not more than(多くても)との対比。

next:fc:239.hint: 少なさを強調する表現
next:fc:239.question: 「たった5ドルしか」を表すのは?
next:fc:239.fullSentence: I have no more than five dollars.
next:fc:239.explanation: no more than = only『たった〜しか』。
next:fc:239.relatedInfo: not more than(せいぜい、意味が中立)とのニュアンスの違いに注意。

next:fc:240.question: I have no less _____ five dollars.
next:fc:240.fullSentence: I have no less than five dollars.
next:fc:240.explanation: no less than = as much/many as『〜も』。
next:fc:240.relatedInfo: 多さを強調するニュアンス。

next:fc:241.hint: 単数の集合名詞を比較対象にした最上級
next:fc:241.question: 「ジョンは家族の中で一番賢い」を表すのは?
next:fc:241.fullSentence: John is the smartest in his family.
next:fc:241.relatedInfo: of+複数(比較対象の集団)との使い分け。

next:fc:242.hint: 彼はその3人の少年の中で一番速く走れる
next:fc:242.question: He can run the fastest _____ the three boys.
next:fc:242.fullSentence: He can run the fastest of the three boys.
next:fc:242.explanation: the+最上級+of+複数(比較対象の集団)。
next:fc:242.relatedInfo: in+単数集合名詞との使い分け。

next:fc:243.hint: 経験を根拠にした最上級構文
next:fc:243.question: 「彼女は私が知る中で最も知的な女性だ」を表すのは?
next:fc:243.answer: the most intelligent woman that I know
choices: the most intelligent woman that I know
the most intelligent woman what I know
most intelligent woman that I know
the more intelligent woman that I know
next:fc:243.fullSentence: She is the most intelligent woman that I know.
next:fc:243.explanation: 最上級+that S have (ever) pp の構文の基本形。
next:fc:243.relatedInfo: that節にはeverを伴うこともある。

next:fc:244.hint: その映画は断然すべての中で一番面白い
next:fc:244.question: The movie is _____ far the most interesting of all.
next:fc:244.fullSentence: The movie is by far the most interesting of all.
next:fc:244.explanation: 最上級の強調はby far, much, far, very, the veryを使う。
next:fc:244.relatedInfo: by farは最上級を強調する代表的な語句。

next:fc:245.hint: 最上級+複数名詞で『最も〜な…の1つ』を表す形
next:fc:245.question: 「これはこれまでで最も偉大な発明の一つだ」を表すのは?
next:fc:245.fullSentence: This is one of the greatest inventions ever.
next:fc:245.explanation: one of the+最上級+複数名詞『最も〜な…の1つ』。
next:fc:245.relatedInfo: 最上級の後の名詞は複数形にする。

next:fc:246.hint: 私はせいぜいかばんを3つしか運べない
next:fc:246.question: I can carry _____ three bags.
next:fc:246.fullSentence: I can carry at most three bags.
next:fc:246.explanation: at most=多くても(=not more than)。
next:fc:246.relatedInfo: at least(少なくとも)との対比。

next:fc:247.hint: 序数を使った最上級表現
next:fc:247.question: 「これは日本で3番目に大きい都市だ」を表すのは?
next:fc:247.fullSentence: This is the third largest city in Japan.
next:fc:247.explanation: the+序数+最上級『〜番目に最も…』。
next:fc:247.relatedInfo: the second, the thirdなど序数を最上級の前に置く。

next:fc:248.hint: 今朝はコーヒーよりむしろ紅茶が飲みたい
next:fc:248.question: I'd like tea _____ coffee this morning.
next:fc:248.fullSentence: I'd like tea rather than coffee this morning.
next:fc:248.explanation: rather than A『Aよりむしろ』。比較級を用いた慣用表現。
next:fc:248.relatedInfo: B rather than A『AよりむしろB』の形でよく使う。
